verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
AYI Katonda bwe ndowooza
Ku bingi bye wampa,
-Emmeeme yange ne yeewuunya,
Era n'ekutenda.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Ne bwe nali nkyatondebwa,
Essanyu lyo-eringi
Walissa mu mwoyo gwange,
Ng'olimpa nze buwa.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
-Omokono gwo gunnywezenga
Nga bwe nkyali-omuto,
Mpite mu buzibu bwonna,
Ntuuke mu bukulu.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Obulamu bwange mu nsi
Leero mbukwasa ggwe,
Era nga mmaze okufa
Ntuule-eyo mu ggulu.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Ggwe,Ayi ow'olubeerera,
Bwe ntyo nkuyimbira;
Kuba-ekitiibwa kyo kingi
Ekitatendeka
